description: x402 pay-per-call API and MCP server: calibrated pump.fun launch-risk checks (P(rug within 5 min), P(true graduation)) and Robinhood Chain Pons V2 launch-curve data.
rules: Base URL is https://api.loopholetape.com. Paid routes answer HTTP 402 with x402 v2 'exact' requirements (USDC on Solana or Base, USDG on Robinhood Chain); pay with an x402 v2 client and retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. No account needed.
Call the free GET /v1/check/coverage?mints=... before paying. Paid checks refuse uncovered mints and stale feeds without charging, so do not answer such a refusal with a new payment.

no_flags_observed means no documented flag was observed, not that a token is safe. The probabilities are calibrated estimates (validation tables at /v1/calibration), not guarantees and not financial advice.
P(rug within 5 minutes) is published only for mints younger than 30 seconds; P(true graduation) at any age. Check meta.is_stale and meta.feed_lag_s before acting on a result.

Before signing, check payTo, network and asset against /.well-known/x402 and enforce a per-call and total spend cap in the client; the Python and TypeScript examples in this repo do this for USDC on Solana.

Without an x402 client: buy a prepaid key once (GET /v1/keys/trial $0.10 or /v1/keys/new $2.00), then send the header X-API-Key: lt_... on paid HTTP routes and on POST /mcp. Treat the key as a secret.

MCP is streamable HTTP at https://api.loopholetape.com/mcp; initialize and tools/list need no payment. A paid tool without payment returns the requirements; retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"].
To monitor mints, poll the free GET /v1/check/watch no faster than every 15 s and buy a paid check with its cursor only when data.has_new_events is true; an unchanged cursor is answered unpaid.
